chunks: Abu al-Numayr, the freed slave of al-Harith ibn al-Mughirah, asked him and said:
Tell me about the child: up to what age do women wash him? He said: "Up to three years."

key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: the young boy or child being referred to in the ruling
key_terms.تُغَسِّلُهُ: wash him, referring to the ritual washing of the deceased
key_terms.ثَلَاثِ سِنِينَ: three years, the age limit mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.مَوْلَى: freed slave or client, describing Abu al-Numayr's relation

ai.seo_question: Up to what age may women wash a young boy according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the washing of a young deceased child by women. It states that this is permitted up to the age of three years.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.429 - Abu al-Numeir, the freed slave of al-Harith ibn al-Mughira, asked Imam Al-Sadiq (as): "Tell me about the age up to which a child can be washed by women."
The Imam (as) replied: "Up to three years old."
